# Daily Briefing – Sunday 6 July

Yesterday was a solid active rest day — 10,843 steps kept you moving without formal training, and burning 2,489 kcal against a 2,300 target gives you a small deficit, which is exactly what you want trending toward that 80-85kg goal. No complaints there.

Recovery tells a mixed story. Your HRV at 96ms sits just below your 101-119ms baseline, and sleep at 6.6 hours is a touch short. Nothing alarming — your resting HR of 49 bpm and stress score of 33 both look excellent — but your body is signalling it needs a little more restoration. If today has a hard session planned, consider dialling intensity back 10-15% or swapping it for an easy aerobic run.

Prioritise sleep tonight — aim for 7.5-8 hours. That HRV will thank you by Monday, and consistency there directly sharpens your race-day fitness.
